name: malformed-csv
description: Malformed and awkward CSV rows must not lose their neighbors. The export carries: a record whose quoted device.hardware.model field contains an embedded newline (the case the old hand-rolled split-on-newlines parser corrupted, taking the record AND desynchronizing the one after it), a row with fewer fields than the header (short rows pad with empty strings), a row with no device.uid (skipped, not imported), and a final well-formed record that proves nothing upstream broke the walk. The record following the quoted-newline row must come out with ITS OWN hostname and IP -- that adjacency is the regression lock. Skips namespaced_ids for consistency with download-results.json: the foreign id is Nexthink's bare device.uid.
